items.title_zh: 基于 PhysioNet 运动想象数据集的 CSP+LDA 脑机接口基线
items.title_en: EEG BCI Baseline with CSP and LDA on PhysioNet Motor Imagery
bullets_zh: 从零实现 CSP，并用 LDA 进行运动想象脑电分类。
在 PhysioNet 数据集上评估，10 名受试者交叉验证准确率为 65.6%。
基于公开 EEG 数据提供紧凑的非侵入式 BCI 基线。
bullets_en: Implements CSP from scratch and LDA for motor imagery EEG classification.
Evaluates on PhysioNet with 65.6% cross-validated accuracy over 10 subjects.
Provides a compact non-invasive BCI baseline using public EEG data.
items.brief: 用 CSP+LDA 在 PhysioNet 运动想象 EEG 上实现非侵入式 BCI 基线。
items.brief_en: Implements CSP and LDA for non-invasive motor imagery EEG on PhysioNet with a reported baseline accuracy.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG brain-computer interface: CSP implemented from scratch + LDA on PhysioNet motor imagery, 65.6% cross-validated over 10 subjects

items.title_zh: 用于脑机接口解码的 EEG-Deformer PyTorch 实现
items.title_en: EEG-Deformer PyTorch Implementation for BCI Decoding
bullets_zh: 用 PyTorch 实现 EEG-Deformer 卷积 Transformer。
面向从非侵入式脑电信号解码心理状态。
提供用于模型实验的深度学习 BCI 代码库。
bullets_en: Implements the EEG-Deformer convolutional transformer in PyTorch.
Targets decoding mental states from non-invasive EEG signals.
Offers a deep-learning BCI codebase for model experimentation.
items.brief: 提供 EEG-Deformer 的 PyTorch 实现，用于非侵入式脑电解码。
items.brief_en: Provides a PyTorch implementation of EEG-Deformer for non-invasive EEG decoding and BCI research.
items.raw_excerpt: Decode mental states from EEG signals using this PyTorch implementation of the EEG-Deformer convolutional transformer for brain-computer interfaces.

items.title_zh: 基于 EEG、SVM/CNN/LSTM 的脑控仿真机器人项目
items.title_en: EEG Mind-Controlled Robot Simulation with SVM, CNN, and LSTM
bullets_zh: 使用 SVM、CNN 和 LSTM 模型从脑电中解码想象手部运动。
控制仿真机器人，作为端到端非侵入式 BCI 演示。
展示面向消费级脑电实验的运动想象控制流程。
bullets_en: Decodes imagined hand movements from EEG using SVM, CNN, and LSTM models.
Steers a simulated robot as an end-to-end non-invasive BCI demonstration.
Shows a motor imagery control pipeline for consumer-style EEG experiments.
items.brief: 用 EEG 想象手部运动控制仿真机器人，展示非侵入式 BCI 控制流程。
items.brief_en: Uses imagined hand movement EEG with SVM/CNN/LSTM to steer a simulated robot in a non-invasive BCI demo.
items.raw_excerpt: Brain-computer interface that decodes imagined hand movements from EEG (SVM, CNN, LSTM) to steer a simulated robot

items.title_zh: EIDOS-BCI：面向脑机接口研究的模块化EEG信号处理框架
items.title_en: EIDOS-BCI: Modular EEG Signal Processing Framework for BCI Research
bullets_zh: GitHub项目提供基于Python/MNE的模块化EEG信号处理框架，用于脑机接口研究。
面向非侵入式EEG工作流，支持预处理与分析流程。
可作为可复现EEG脑机接口实验的开源起点。
bullets_en: GitHub project providing a modular Python/MNE framework for EEG signal processing in BCI research.
Targets non-invasive EEG workflows, supporting preprocessing and analysis pipelines.
Useful as an open-source starting point for reproducible EEG-based BCI experiments.
items.brief: EIDOS-BCI是Python/MNE模块化EEG处理框架，适合非侵入式BCI研究。
items.brief_en: EIDOS-BCI is a Python/MNE modular EEG processing framework for non-invasive BCI research.
items.raw_excerpt: A modular EEG signal processing framework for Brain–Computer Interface (BCI) research using Python and MNE.

items.title_zh: bci-mcp：面向Claude与脑机接口客户端的实时EEG脑状态MCP服务器
items.title_en: bci-mcp: Live EEG Brain-State MCP Server for Claude and BCI Clients
bullets_zh: GitHub工具包可实时流式传输EEG脑状态，如专注、平静与注意力。
通过模型上下文协议服务器向Claude及其他MCP客户端暴露EEG数据。
展示如何将消费级或科研EEG设备接入基于大语言模型的BCI工作流。
bullets_en: GitHub toolkit that streams live EEG-derived brain states such as focus, calm, and attention.
Exposes EEG data through a Model Context Protocol server for Claude and other MCP clients.
Shows how consumer or research EEG devices can be connected to LLM-based BCI workflows.
items.brief: bci-mcp把实时EEG脑状态接入Claude/MCP，适合非侵入式BCI开发。
items.brief_en: bci-mcp streams live EEG brain states into Claude and MCP clients for non-invasive BCI development.
items.raw_excerpt: Stream live EEG brain state (focus, calm, attention) from any EEG device into Claude and any MCP client — a real Model Context Protocol server + brain-computer interface toolkit.

items.title_zh: 基于运动想象与ErrP的3D打印手部矫形器BCI项目
bullets_zh: GitHub项目构建由运动想象控制的3D打印手部矫形器。
它使用错误相关电位（ErrP）作为奖励，随时间改进控制。
提供振动触觉反馈，同时测量身体图式整合程度。
bullets_en: GitHub project builds a 3D-printed hand orthosis controlled by motor imagery.
It uses error-related potentials (ErrP) as reward to improve control over time.
Vibrotactile feedback is provided while measuring body-schema incorporation.
items.brief: 基于运动想象与ErrP控制3D打印手部矫形器的非侵入BCI项目。
items.brief_en: Non-invasive BCI project using motor imagery and ErrP to control a 3D-printed hand orthosis.
items.raw_excerpt: Construimos una órtesis de mano impresa en 3D que se mueve con imaginación motora y aprende sola a obedecer mejor, usando la señal de error del cerebro (ErrP) como recompensa. Devuelve sensación por vibración y medimos cuánto la incorpora el usuario a su esquema corporal, en la línea de Stanisa Raspopovic.

bullets_zh: GitHub项目收集BCI法律与监管法规并提供追踪界面。

对非侵入式BCI开发者、研究人员和合规团队有用。
bullets_en: GitHub project collects BCI legal and regulatory acts and provides a tracking UI.
It supports monitoring regulatory changes relevant to BCI products and research.
Useful for non-invasive BCI developers, researchers, and compliance teams.

items.brief_en: Open-source collector and UI for tracking BCI legal/regulatory acts, useful for compliance monitoring.
